intro.fr: Mirror's Edge se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Mirror's Edge can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: IronMonkey Studios sort Mirror's Edge en 2009.
text.en: IronMonkey Studios releases Mirror's Edge in 2009.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, mirrors-edge-v1.0.0.
text.en: The first version, mirrors-edge-v1.0.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version mirrors-edge-v1.2.0, la plus récente des 3 versions au nom du jeu sur ce dépôt au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version mirrors-edge-v1.2.0 is released, the latest of the 3 versions named after the game on this repository as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Mirror's Edge figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Mirror's Edge is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
